chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Ubayd ibn Zurarah, who said:
I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who goes out for hunting: should he shorten or complete? He said: He should complete, because it is not travel in truth.

key_terms.أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam being asked for the ruling
key_terms.أَيَقْصُرُ: whether he shortens the salat during travel
key_terms.الصَّيْدِ: hunting; the purpose of the journey discussed in the hadith
key_terms.مَسِيرِ حَقٍّ: a rightful or valid journey in the legal sense relevant to prayer shortening
key_terms.يُتِمُّ: he performs the salat in full

ai.seo_question: Does a person traveling for hunting shorten the prayer or perform it in full?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding salat during travel undertaken for hunting. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that such a person should perform the prayer in full, because this journey is not regarded here as a rightful qualifying travel for shortening.
